revisions.goal: Prepare and deploy the EVE 0.6.0 release.
revisions.acceptanceCriteria: Version metadata is updated to 0.6.0, release notes/changelog reflect the release, the relevant verification suite passes, the release is deployed using the repository's configured release path, and both the implementation commit and EVE product-history commit are created.

milestones.title: Discover release process
milestones.goal: Inspect package metadata, changelog, and deploy scripts to determine the correct release steps.

milestones.title: Prepare 0.6.0 metadata
milestones.goal: Update versioned files and release notes for 0.6.0.

milestones.title: Verify release
milestones.goal: Run the relevant tests/builds before creating the EVE snapshot.

milestones.title: Deploy and record
milestones.goal: Deploy the release, commit implementation, record EVE snapshot, and commit the EVE record.

revisions.configuredSuite: Repository release verification and build/test commands discovered from local tooling.
